classification.difficultyReason: Recognise that the marked exterior angle requires first finding an interior angle with inverse tangent and then taking its supplement.

content.prompt: Calculate the value of $\theta$ in these diagrams. Answer to 1 d.p.

spec.description: Right triangle with base 5 and vertical leg 4; the hypotenuse extends beyond the upper vertex. The exterior angle is between the downward vertical leg and the upward-right extension. Ordinary source blue strokes are rendered black.
spec.mathematics: The interior upper angle has tangent 5/4; theta is its supplement.

answer.worked:
Let $\alpha$ be the interior angle at the upper vertex.
$$\begin{align*}\tan\alpha&=\frac{5}{4}\\\alpha&=\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{5}{4}\right)\\\theta&=180^{\circ}-\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{5}{4}\right)\\\theta&\approx128.7^{\circ}\end{align*}$$
Angles on a straight line sum to $180^{\circ}$.
